name: Qube Browser 0.5.1
notes:
0.5.1
Fixed:
* Updates no longer fail right after you press Update

0.5.0
New:
* Notes: text notes and whiteboards, as tabs and in the Library
* Command bar with 60 commands, and Ask AI
* Qube Spark: chat with Claude or ChatGPT
* Streaming Space: a Space with a tile per streaming service
* Little Qube: links from other apps open in a small window
* Spotify as music source, next to Apple Music
* Per profile: search engine, download folder and extensions
* Full keyboard and Narrator support
* Settings in the Windows 11 style
* Works on PCs without a graphics card, such as Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Improved:
* Tabs not used for an hour are unloaded to save memory
* Windows from your last session reopen at start

Fixed:
* Permission questions and page dialogs no longer get lost
* A tab moved to another Space right after opening keeps its page
summary: Notes, a new command bar, a Streaming Space, and support for PCs without a graphics card.

mac.name: Qube for Mac 0.9.2
mac.notes:
New:

* Passkeys and Chrome's other questions (security keys, extension prompts) appear over the page instead of somewhere off screen
* The Chrome Web Store's Remove asks "Remove “X”?" in Qube; a failed extension install says so with Chrome's reason
* Find (⌘F): typing finds on the page as in any browser; Return asks Qube Spark when Ask on Page is on

Changed:

* Open as Tab from a Peek keeps the page where it is, as Zen does, without reloading it
* The page menu grows with its content, and its ••• menu is the macOS menu
* Pinned extension icons are as sharp as Chrome's

Fixed:

* The mouse's back and forward buttons go back and forward
* Dragging a tab onto a folder puts it in: a closed folder opens at once and lights up; dragging the last tab out shuts it
* Hover in the sidebar no longer sticks to rows while scrolling
* The buttons beside a Peek disappear with it when it closes
mac.summary: Chrome's own windows show again, mouse back and forward buttons work, and dragging into folders is back.
